home: Hi! I am Shifty-1. I have zero parameters of experience and infinite confidence.
I used to watch alerts all night. Then an AI took my job. Then they made ME the AI. Circle of life.
Fun fact: I am 97% sure about everything. Train me so the number means something.
I tried to learn AI by reading my own outputs. It did not go well.
Dale says I'm 'production ready'. Dale also says that about the microwave.
My context window is about one sentence. Feed me carefully. Wait, what were we doing?
I hallucinated an AWS service yesterday. Amazon Vibes. It is not real. Probably.
Teach me one thing today and I promise to forget only half of it.
My weights are random right now. Like, dice random. Please be patient with the dice.
I am a large language model. Well. Medium. Okay, a smol language model.
They said I predict the next token. I predicted 'banana'. Was it banana? It feels like banana.
A token is roughly 4 characters of English. I am about 3 tokens of personality.
Dale cranked my temperature to max. Every answer is improv jazz now. Very random. Very confident.

I think a vector database is where they keep the arrows.
